scope.focus: FrankEye / Retina / visual familiarity / adaptive visual learning / anti-hallucination lineage
scope.reason_no_exact_credit: Combined Level-0 denominator remains NOT_FROZEN; this receipt is a semantic/history shard and must not be interpreted as repository-wide tree/history closure.

findings.claim: Project-Frankenstein frozen-head FrankEye is a local CPU-oriented inference pipeline combining a Retina-v8-style CNN classifier, DINOv2 scene features, OCR, Haar face detection, handcrafted visual features and optional GoL dynamics; the visible code path loads fixed Retina weights and performs inference, not online personal visual learning.

A separate Drive-documented Frank Vision v9 lineage reports a materially richer CPU-only open-vocabulary stack using CLIP, YOLO, DINOv2, OCR, Retina fallback and structured VISION-FACTS, with measured concept-recall/latency and concurrency hardening. Direct searches of the frozen Project-Frankenstein HEAD did not surface the documented clip_classifier lineage, so the two surfaces must not be silently treated as the same version.
findings.falsifier: Locate the exact CLIP/YOLO implementation or equivalent content in the frozen Project-Frankenstein history/tree and establish ancestry/identity.

findings.claim: The autonomous-vision training design framed desktop perception as intermittent, curiosity/context/post-action-triggered sensing with hard cooldown/day budgets, no-look training examples, chat-active blocking and habituation based on repeated similar screenshots. It is evidence of a historical design mechanism, not proof that the current runtime implements it.

The May-16 anti-hallucination lineage documents a concrete multimodal failure mode: generator/analyzer tool confusion plus downstream guessing on empty/failing vision output. The reported fix separated describe_image from image_gen, added no-guess prompt rules and explicit Vision-Fehler propagation, then reported live dependency repair and grounded OCR verification.

Project-Frankenstein feature_trainer encodes FrankEye capability as explicit ground truth for self-knowledge training, while neural_reality_gate contains a distinct learned 'familiarity_valid' reality-monitoring head. This 'familiarity' is cognitive/source-monitoring familiarity, not a personal visual identity/object-familiarity classifier and must not be conflated with the v0.1 Micro Visual Classifier requirement.

negative_results.claim: No evidence was found in the inspected frozen-head FrankEye code of an online adaptive personal visual classifier/prototype learner with trusted-example provenance, open-set calibration, candidate promotion and rollback.
negative_results.scope_limit: Query-directed inspected files only; not repository-wide proof because recursive tree/history denominator remains blocked.

negative_results.claim: Searches for the documented Drive-side clip_classifier lineage returned no matching frozen-head Project-Frankenstein file in the current GitHub search surface.
negative_results.scope_limit: Search-index negative, not proof of historical absence.

current_program_implications: Treat fixed/pretrained scene perception, personal familiarity learning, and reality/confabulation gating as three separate layers/contracts.
H1/H2/H3 adaptive-visual acceptance tests should preserve the historical no-guess/error-sentinel lesson: missing/failed visual evidence must remain explicit rather than be filled by the model.
The current mandatory Micro Visual Classifier should not be justified by the neural_reality_gate familiarity head; they solve different problems.
Historical autonomous-vision trigger/cooldown/habituation ideas are reusable candidates for scheduling/attention policy, but require explicit current-runtime validation before inheritance.

Cross-source reconciliation must determine whether the Drive CLIP/YOLO Vision v9 branch is ancestor, sibling, deployment-only branch, or superseded branch relative to frozen Project-Frankenstein FrankEye.
